{{Quote|This must be the Land of the dandelion warriors. Now I've got to find a star urchin. I guess this is the place|[[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket W. Warrick]]|<ref name="To Save Deej">{{Ewoks|To Save Deej}}</ref>}}
The '''Land of the dandelion warriors''' was a meadow located on the forest [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], in the leading edge of the grasslands, against the border of the [[Great Forest]]. The [[Plant/Legends|botanical]] [[Sentience/Legends|semi-sentients]] who called themselves [[fftssfft]]&mdash;also known as the "dandelion warriors" by the [[Bear/Legends|bear]]-like [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]]&mdash;grew in the high [[Grass/Legends|grass]] of that meadow and were very protective of their territory.
